why: What a push and a read of all widgets answer: an array, with nulls omitted. The marketplace widget has no userId or ttlSeconds on the wire, and each must read as null -- a ttlSeconds defaulted to 0 is a widget the client blanks at once, and a userId defaulted to 0 re-pushed as a USER target names nobody. content is open per kind (a list of strings, a list of objects with a number in them), and an SDK that types it narrowly drops what the participant was meant to see.

source.constructed: widgets are cleared when a session closes, so GET /v1/marketplaces/{marketplaceId}/widgets/all on a capture server is usually empty and has no shape to compare. Modelled on fm-server's fm.data.widget.Widget (JsonInclude NON_NULL; createdBy/lastModifiedBy are JsonIgnore'd) and checked against a local push on 2026-10-01: the server stores an absent emphasis as normal and omits an absent userId and ttlSeconds.
